newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chinese retailer Xinghua to launch A share offer.
newsitem.headline: Chinese retailer Xinghua to launch A share offer.

text.p: Retailer Foshan Xinghua Group Co Ltd will launch an offer of 16 million A shares on the Shenzhen bourse by the end of this month, a company spokesman said on Thursday.
The offer, approved by the China Securities Regulatory Commission, has been priced at 6.74 yuan per share, he told the China Securities Bulletin, a Hong Kong-based newsletter.
The company, which operates the biggest department store in the city of Foshan in Guangdong province, plans to use the money raised from the offer to expand its retail operations, the official said.
Guangdong Securities Co Ltd has been named as the offer's chief underwriter, he said.

The official said the company forecast net profits of 35 million yuan for 1997, and added that it had after-tax profits of 21 million yuan in the January-September period of 1996 against 28.68 million yuan for the whole of 1995.
After the offer, Xinghua would have a capital of 60 million shares, comprised of 23.36 million state shares, 11.84 million legal person shares, 16 million A shares and 8.8 million staff shares.
